author: sonnet
label: seeded-07-01
changes: Added a terms section defining replica, mark, lookback, staging, fact table, etl_runs and scheduler, since the junior asked what these mean.
Spelled out Extract: reads the mark, applies the 2h lookback, truncates then loads stg_orders, includes soft-deleted rows.
Decided merge logic: newest updated_at per order_id, upsert only if not older, is_deleted from deleted_at, no physical deletes.
Decided the mark advances in the same warehouse transaction as the merge, so a half-loaded night is never visible and failed runs leave it untouched.
Defined etl_runs contents and who reads it; stated staging is emptied at the start of each attempt.
Spelled out retries (3 attempts, 15 min apart, page after the third) and that the 06:00 check is independent and only alerts to #data-alerts.
Specified reconciliation: compare per creation day, reload mismatched days through staging and the same merge, mark untouched.
Added a failure table, a short rollout section, and open questions (scheduler product, initial mark and backfill, creation column name).
Expanded the diagram to show data flow, state tables and triggers.
Added Attempt term: Extract plus Merge in one job, succeeding or failing as a whole, with its run date (Q10, Q13).
Step 2 and diagram: Merge runs in the same job right after Extract, not started by the scheduler (Q10).
Steps 1 and 2: Merge reads the new mark from this attempt's etl_runs row; empty new mark means mark unchanged (Q11).

Step 3: defined failure as error, crash or timeout; retry waits 15 minutes after the failure so attempts never overlap; manual rerun is an ordinary attempt; nothing runs after the page until next night (Q12, Q14).
Step 4: defined tonight's run as today's UTC run date and covered still-running attempts (Q13).
Step 5: scheduler starts reconciliation after the Sunday Merge commits, skips it if that did not commit, empties staging first and merges all mismatched days once (Q15, Q16).
Failure summary: added rows for hung attempts and for a Sunday with no committed load.
Open questions: added the attempt timeout value.
Added a kind column (nightly or reconcile) to etl_runs so reconciliation has its own row and is not mistaken for the night's load.
Step 4: the 06:00 check reads only nightly rows and ignores reconcile rows.
Step 3: on timeout the scheduler kills the job, so a hung attempt cannot keep writing.
Step 2: Merge checks its etl_runs row is still running before commit and rolls back otherwise, guarding against a stray job.
Step 5: reconciliation records its own etl_runs row, leaves its new mark empty, and uses the same timeout, kill, retry and paging rules.
Failure summary: the hang row now says the job is killed and cannot commit.
Diagram: the 06:00 check edge now says it reads today's nightly status.

Merge step: etl_watermark is set to the greater of the current mark and the new mark, so the mark never moves backward (a night with only old overlap rows leaves it unchanged); this replaces the plain write and the empty-only exception.
High-water mark term: added that it only ever moves forward.
Merged the step 2 mark rules into one sentence: mark is the greater of new and current, so old-only or empty nights leave it unchanged.
Moved the reason staging is emptied at the start of each attempt into the stg_orders term.
Moved the reason reconciliation waits for the nightly load into step 5, where it applies.
Cut repeated retry and kill wording in step 5 and the failure table; step 5 refers to step 3.
Cut the repeated 'initial mark' open question from Rollout, keeping it only under Open questions.
Tightened the Scheduler and mark terms; added 'the mark' as a short name.
Kept the diagram and every stated requirement unchanged: 02:00 start, 2h lookback, 90 min, 15 min and two retries, 06:00 alert, 30-day reconciliation with count and checksum.
holes: Q1: What is the Scheduler here (cron, Airflow, something else), and what exactly does it start at 02:00 UTC? (author: The brief says only 'the scheduler'; the product (cron, Airflow, other) is not known. What it does is decided: it starts the run at 02:00 UTC, retries failed attempts and pages on-call. Added the unknown to Open questions.)
